source.author: CDmir (Čestmír Dammer)
source.note: Wave-1 row 29 named the Quaternius animated chicken (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius 'Chicken' (Textured Cute Monster Pack, OpenGameArt) was rendered and is a round big-eyed monster blob, not a farm chicken; no reachable Quaternius farm pack has one. This CC0 hen (license.txt in the zip: CC0, Čestmír Dammer) reads as a farm chicken at a glance and has idle, walk, eat, peck and death clips. Its .blend uses legacy Blender Internal materials; the pipeline reads the one colour image (UV-Texture.png) and flattens it: the brown clusters draw as a buff hen, the pale foot/beak cluster as yellow legs, the pink comb clusters as a red comb (one pale cluster that also dots the body goes to the coat). The sculpt base mesh ('Cylinder', a multires cage around the bird) is dropped. Height 0.4 m: a standing hen to the top of the comb.
